name: poetic-line-zine-poster
title_zh: 上半原片，下半抽成诗意线
tagline_zh: 竖版照片加抽象，像一本薄刊物的一页
desc_en: Create a clean vertical photo-and-abstraction editorial artwork from an uploaded portrait, travel photo, animal, plant, architecture, object, or scene. Preserve the source photo, distill its relationships into broad charcoal sweeps and one structural chromatic scribble, add restrained experimental English typography, and deliver an exact requested aspect ratio through deterministic composition and
why_zh: 人像、旅行、动物、建筑都能进：上面保住照片，下面用线重新说一遍。
limit_zh: 页是竖的编辑页，不是横版大片，也不是九宫格。
